blocking_findings.title: The accepted report grammar is a synthetic wrapper, not the native Synopsys report grammar
blocking_findings.evidence: A repo-native DC report_area file is rejected for lacking the custom Tool header, while the admitted fixture uses only 9-10 hand-authored lines per report.
blocking_findings.impact: A real DC/PT/PTPX/memory run cannot flow through the reviewed extractor without an unbound manual normalization step.

blocking_findings.title: Raw reports are not semantically bound to the row configuration/design
blocking_findings.evidence: The row validator accepts a wrong Design label and accepts row-0 raw reports under the row-1 extraction receipt/configuration SHA.
blocking_findings.impact: All report hashes may be present while a report is attributed to the wrong Table-A configuration.

caveats.title: Power projection omits leakage
caveats.impact: total_power_mw is dynamic-only and must not be described as total chip power.
